objectives.summary: The project aims to teach participants how to design and code a 2D mobile game using the Flame Engine and Flutter within a structured course format. It focuses on delivering essential game development fundamentals and practical coding skills in less than 6 hours, culminating in the development of the retro game Asteroids.
key_points: The course is designed to help users set up and understand the language elements of Flutter/Dart.
Participants will learn to code a full mobile game in less than 6 hours.
The course targets game enthusiasts and coders who want to create their own mobile games.
The project includes a unique architectural approach to teaching game development.
The course will involve both coding and designing the game in a professional manner.
Asteroids is chosen as the game to be developed due to its suitability for learning 2D game engine fundamentals.

innovation.summary: The project introduces the Flame Engine, a minimalist 2D game engine built on the Flutter framework, which allows for efficient mobile game development. It emphasizes a lightweight design, enabling developers to create games with a single code base for multiple platforms, including iOS and Android. The project also includes various visual aids and diagrams to illustrate the game engine's architecture and functionality.
key_points: The Flame Engine is a minimalist 2D game engine that operates on the Flutter framework.
It is lightweight with a small footprint, making it suitable for mobile game development.
The Flutter framework supports one code base for deployment across multiple platforms.
Developers can create custom GUIs independent of the specific OS GUI using Flutter.
The project includes visual content such as diagrams and flowcharts to explain the game engine's structure and processes.
The project features a detailed description of the 'Game Loop' process, which includes getting input data, updating game state, and rendering.
